stories.title: H Mart in Sacramento reveals opening date for Mack Road location
stories.summary: H Mart will open its long-awaited South Sacramento supermarket on Dec. 17, according to a sign posted outside the Mack Road store.

stories.title: Live Oak City Council election top vote-getter faces three felony charges
stories.summary: A Live Oak City Council election top vote-getter is facing multiple charges involving allegations of child sexual abuse. He denies the allegations.

stories.title: Black Friday crowds pack Sacramento-area malls as holiday shopping season begins
stories.summary: Shoppers say they prefer the Black Friday experience to shopping online.

stories.title: Motorcyclist killed after being thrown into water in Sacramento County crash
stories.summary: A motorcyclist died after being thrown into the water during a crash near Twin Cities Road.

stories.title: Rocklin shoppers share why Black Friday is a holiday tradition
stories.summary: Early shoppers at Rocklin's Bass Pro Shops took advantage of Black Friday deals, including one customer who arrived before 4 a.m.

stories.title: Fire breaks out at three-story building in downtown Stockton on Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Stockton firefighters contained a Thanksgiving night fire to a downtown business on North Sutter Street, preventing it from spreading to the rest of the building.

stories.title: Car crashes into downtown Sacramento office building
stories.summary: Sacramento police said the driver intentionally drove into the downtown office building just after 10:30 p.m. Thursday. No one was inside at the time.

stories.title: Sacramento Weather Forecast
stories.summary: Dense fog Saturday morning with some afternoon clearing. Sunday showers and thunderstorms.

stories.title: Stockton faith leaders call for action after 6-year-old girl is fatally shot
stories.summary: "As long as we're here, we're not going to live in fear."

stories.title: Pedestrian killed after being struck by vehicle on Highway 99 in Sacramento
stories.summary: A man was killed after being struck by a vehicle while walking in the southbound lanes of Highway 99 north of Calvine Road.

stories.title: Mother spends Thanksgiving without her missing son, pleads public for help
stories.summary: "It's been horrible. It's not like Ryan to go missing like this. He's never done it before, so I'm just anxiety-ridden."

stories.title: Politics at the Thanksgiving table? California voters weigh in after midterm elections
stories.summary: As voters reflect on a consequential midterm election, many say politics should stay off the holiday menu — while others are open minded.
